title: Ex-Batanes Gov. Cayco pulls ahead in Batanes special polls partial count

blocks.text: TUGUEGARAO CITY — Former three-term governor Marilou Cayco widened her lead with 3,431 votes in the partial and unofficial manual canvassing of election returns from six towns in Batanes during the special congressional elections on Saturday, Nov. 28. The partial results released by the Provincial Board of Canvassers (PBOC) covered clustered precincts in Basco, Mahatao, Ivana, Uyugan, Sabtang and Itbayat. READ: Batanes voters cast ballots in special congressional election As of 6:30 p.m., Cayco was ahead of her closest rival, Luis Andres Abad, son of former Budget Secretary Florencio Abad, who garnered 2,654 votes.
